newsitem.title: DUBAI: SOCCER-DRAW FOR THE 1996 ASIAN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DRAW FOR THE 1996 ASIAN CUP.

text.p: Title-holders Japan drew a relatively easy group on Monday for December's Asian Cup final round.
Japan, victors in 1992 over Saudi Arabia, were seeded in Group C to face China, Syria and Uzbekistan in Al Ain. Syria and Uzbekistan only just squeezed into the 12-team final round.

South Korea, who have reached the final tournaments of the last three World Cups, are favourites to win Group A in Abu Dhabi. They were drawn with hosts the United Arab Emirates, the UAE's old Gulf rivals Kuwait and Indonesia.
Saudi Arabia head the Dubai-based Group B which also includes Iran, Thailand and Iraq.

Iran have won the Asian Cup three times, Thailand won Sunday's Tiger Cup final in Singapore, while Iraq were the last team to qualify for the final round of this tournament with victories over Pakistan and Oman last month.
The top two teams in each group and the two third-placed sides with the best records qualify for the quarter-finals.
The tournament, organised by the 44-member Asian Football Confederation, runs from December 4 to 21.
Group A (in Abu Dhabi) - UAE, South Korea, Kuwait, Indonesia
Group B (in Dubai) - Saudi Arabia, Iran, Iraq, Thailand
Group C (in Al Ain) - Japan, China, Syria, Uzbekistan.
